ideas.name: Quarterly Expiration Week Returns
ideas.claim: The S&P 500 averaged a loss during weeks containing quarterly triple-witching expirations.
ideas.quote: The S&P 500 has averaged a 0.53% loss during these weeks with 53% of the returns positive.

rules.filters: Weeks containing the third Friday of March, June, September or December

ideas.claimed_result: Average weekly return of -0.53%; 53% of weeks positive, using data since 2017.

ideas.name: Monthly Options Expiration Week
ideas.claim: Hold the S&P 500 during monthly options expiration week.
ideas.quote: Note that if we enter at the close of the trading week preceding the options expiration week, the average gain increases to 0.35% per trade.

rules.timeframe: Daily; approximately one week holding time
rules.entry: Buy at the expiration week's Monday open or the preceding week's close.
rules.exit: Close on expiration day, usually Friday; Thursday if Friday is a holiday.

ideas.claimed_result: Average gain of 0.35% per trade with entry at the preceding week's close; test period stated as after 1990.
required_data: S&P 500 index open and close prices
